fields.summary_ko.0: VA Tech Wabag stock plummeted 10.54% on November 16 to reach ₹1,825, after Saudi Arabia's water authority announced cancellation of a seawater desalination project worth ₹2,332 crore.
fields.summary_ko.1: The 300 MLD Yanbu seawater desalination project ($272 million) awarded in July 2025 was cancelled in bidding due to the customer's internal reasons, affecting the overseas order pipeline.
